title: Add talk to an existing scheduled day

steps.name: Add a talk occurrence
steps.do: Open **Add Meet the Guardians talk occurrence**. Choose **Location** **Africa Savanna** and **Talk name** **African Penguin**, set **Date** to today, enter **Talk time** **11:00 AM**, then submit.
steps.expect: Success that the occurrence was added.

steps.name: Build animals first
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Itinerary**. **Build Itinerary** / **Edit Itinerary**, set the visit date to **today**, add **African Lion** and **African Penguin** without adding talks yet, then **Finish**.
steps.expect: Both animals are on the itinerary.

steps.name: Schedule Lion over the talk window
steps.do: Open **Day Planner View**. Use **Schedule an item** to schedule **African Lion** at **11:00 AM** (keep a normal duration). Leave **African Penguin** unscheduled.
steps.expect: **African Lion** has a timeline pill starting at **11:00 AM**. **African Penguin** stays unscheduled.

steps.name: Edit and add the overlapping talk
steps.do: Click **Edit Itinerary**. Continue to Meet the Guardians and add the **African Penguin** **11:00 AM** talk.
steps.expect: The talk is selected in the builder.

steps.name: Finish triggers update plan
steps.expect: **Add Guardians Talk?** appears (confirm uses **Update Plan**), with messaging that the talk will be placed at its offered time and other items will be rescheduled around it.

steps.name: Talk on Day Planner
steps.do: Open **Day Planner View** and find the talk.
steps.expect: The talk already has a timeline pill at **11:00 AM**. **African Lion** has shifted off that slot and is scheduled around the talk.

steps.name: List matches
steps.do: Open **List View**, then return to **Day Planner View**.
steps.expect: The talk appears on the list and remains scheduled on the planner.
